name: AURALiC
usb_vendor_ids_source: Linux kernel USB audio quirk tables, sound/usb/quirks.c (d2636407bf8c, 2026-11-12) and sound/usb/quirks-table.h (e7c66b3e249e, 2026-11-04)
_refused: Read 2026-11-25 and refused. AURALiC's own Terms of Service, from the page that says « This website is operated by AURALiC Holdings Inc. », SECTION 2: « You agree not to reproduce, duplicate, copy, sell, resell or exploit any portion of the Service, use of the Service, or access to the Service or any contact on the website through which the service is provided, without express written permission by us. » And SECTION 10: « you are prohibited from using the site or its content: (a) for any unlawful purpose; [...] (i) to spam, phish, pharm, pretext, spider, crawl, or scrape » Two independent bars, and the second names scraping among the prohibited uses. Footer: « (c) 2025 AURALIC. All rights reserved. » No product page was opened for its specifications and no record will exist under this brand.
_the_terms_had_to_be_read_from_an_ARCHIV: AURALiC has no reachable English web presence. us.auralic.com, the Shopify store that WAS the English site, no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN), along with support., docs., store., forum., download. and the auralic.us, .eu and .audio domains. auralic.com and www.auralic.com still resolve, to 52.58.10.149, but present a TLS certificate valid only for *.pro.centribal.com - an unrelated third party - so both curl and a browser refuse with ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID. The reader did NOT disable certificate verification, and gave the right reason: content served under someone else's certificate could not be attributed to AURALiC anyway. So the clause was read from the Internet Archive capture of 2025-10-07. That is weaker evidence than a live page and it is enough HERE, because a refusal costs the catalogue nothing it can get wrong: the worst case is that a maker who would now permit reuse is left out. An archived PERMISSION would not have been enough.
_the_Chinese_host_is_a_separate_and_UNAN: www.auralic.com.cn and auralic.cn are the only live hosts - one WordPress site, Chinese only, operated by a different entity, 卡宁科技（北京）有限公司 under ICP filing 京ICP备2020035368号-1. It has seven pages and NO terms, legal, copyright or privacy page; a full-text sweep of every page and product record for 版权, 转载, 复制, 知识产权 and the English equivalents found nothing. So for that host the honest statement is « no terms page found, so no prohibition could be checked » - which is not permission. Its product library holds fifteen entries: VEGA S1, G2.2, G2.1 and G1; ALTAIR G2.2, G2.1, G1.1 and G1; ARIES S1, G2.2, G2.1, G1.1 and G1; SIRIUS G2.1; LEO GX.1. Nothing was taken from it. Two hosts, two answers, and NEITHER is a yes - which is why this brand is refused on the maker's own English clause rather than left unestablished on the Chinese host's silence.
_what_is_lost: AURALiC builds its own upsampling engine, which makes it one of the few makers whose documentation would have described what the device DOES to an incoming signal rather than only what it accepts - the exact thing this catalogue exists to record. The English PDFs that answered it are all on the dead hosts: flexible_filter_mode.pdf, VEGA_USERSGUIDE_R1.pdf, ARIES specification.pdf. Fifteen models unread.
_it_can_be_lifted: Conditioned on « express written permission by us ». On the letter list - and the only reachable contact route is the Chinese site's 联系我们 page, since the English presence is down.
